description: This PHP class defines an admin form for editing categories within the Goteo platform, including form creation, validation, and saving logic.

classes.name: AdminCategoryEditForm
classes.description: A form processor class for editing categories in the admin panel, handling form creation, validation, and data persistence.

methods.name: getConstraints
methods.description: Returns validation constraints for the form, specifically a NotBlank constraint.

methods.name: createForm
methods.description: Builds the form with fields for name, description, social commitments, footprints, and SDGs, populating choices from related models.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and saves form data into the model, replacing SDGs and footprints associations.
